WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT p.account_id, d.A3 AS region, p.order_count,
       p.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM per_account) AS difference
FROM per_account AS p
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
